label.title: Healthcare System Goals and Approaches

claims.claim_text: Commitment to provide access to affordable health insurance.
Support for a national healthcare system like Medicare For All.
Support for increasing healthcare choice and options.
Commitment to strengthen coverage across all health plans.
Commitment to build a health care system that provides universal health care coverage.
Commitment to improve health care access and affordability in the U.S. territories.
Commitment to fight for a comprehensive system of primary health care, including dental, mental health care, and low-cost prescription drugs.
Commitment to keep healthcare costs low.
More than 100 million Americans depend on Medicare or Medicaid for their healthcare.
Commitment to end unaffordable, unavailable health care.
Support for health justice through Medicare for All.
